description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the tarot card workflow: turn an owned image's subject into a tarot card. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_tarot_card with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_tarot_card.

sourceImageId.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery

name: chargen_quote_recipe_tarot_card
title: Quote tarot card
